title: Mortgage Market Structure and the Transmission of Monetary Policy During the Great Inflation
title_zh: 大通胀时期抵押贷款市场结构与货币政策传导
title_primary: 大通胀时期抵押贷款市场结构与货币政策传导
title_secondary: Mortgage Market Structure and the Transmission of Monetary Policy During the Great Inflation
authors: Aaron Hedlund, Kieran Larkin, Kurt Mitman, Serdar Ozkan
official: 官方在线 2025-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of mortgage market structures on shaping economic responses to the unprecedented interest rate and inflation dynamics of 2021-2024. We first empirically document that economies with a larger share of variable-rate mortgages exhibit stronger responses in house prices to monetary policy shocks. We then develop and calibrate a structural model of the housing market to demonstrate that these mortgage structures can account for a substantial portion of the divergent house price paths observed across the U.S., Canada, Sweden, and the U.K. during the Great Inflation. Our analysis reveals that early pandemic mortgage rate cuts drove 45% of the U.S. house price boom. Economies dominated by adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs) show greater price sensitivity to monetary tightening, while fixed-rate mortgage (FRM) regimes exhibit more pronounced path dependence due to a lock-in effect. These dynamics have significant distributional consequences, with low-income homeowners benefiting most from the initial low-rate environment, especially in FRM regimes. Finally, we show that the preferred monetary tightening path is regime-dependent, as a policy counterfactual reveals that FRM-dominant economies benefit more from a shorter and sharper tightening schedule.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了抵押贷款市场结构如何影响经济对2021-2024年空前利率与通胀动态的响应。我们首先通过实证记录表明，在浮动利率抵押贷款占比较高的经济体中，房价对货币政策冲击的反应更为强烈。随后，我们构建并校准了一个住房市场结构模型，以证明这些抵押贷款结构能够解释大通胀期间美国、加拿大、瑞典和英国所观察到的房价路径差异的相当大一部分。我们的分析揭示，疫情初期的抵押贷款利率下调推动了美国房价繁荣的45%。以可调利率抵押贷款（ARMs）为主导的经济体对货币紧缩表现出更高的价格敏感性，而固定利率抵押贷款（FRM）体制则因锁定效应而展现出更明显的路径依赖性。这些动态具有显著的分配后果，低收入房主从最初的低利率环境中获益最多，尤其是在FRM体制下。最后，我们表明，偏好的货币紧缩路径具有体制依赖性，因为一项政策反事实分析显示，以FRM为主导的经济体从更短且更陡峭的紧缩日程中获益更多。

title: Quota Adjustment Process
title_zh: 配额调整过程
title_primary: 配额调整过程
title_secondary: Quota Adjustment Process
authors: Kumano, Taro, Kurino, Morimitsu
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: In designing priority-based matching problems such as school choice, the quota of each school is, to some extent, a design variable. We define an ex-post student-optimal stable matching (ESOSM) as a matching that is stable at some implementable quota distribution and not Pareto dominated by any other stable matching among all implementable quota distributions. We propose a novel mechanism called a quota adjustment process (QAP) that improves existing stable mechanisms by endogenously finding an ESOSM and the corresponding optimal quota distribution for any preference relation. This method has been successfully implemented at the University of Tsukuba in Japan since 2021.
abstract_zh: 在设计基于优先级的匹配问题（如学校选择）时，每所学校的配额在一定程度上是一个设计变量。我们将事后学生最优稳定匹配（ESOSM）定义为在某种可实施的配额分配下稳定，并且不被任何其他在所有可实施配额分配中的稳定匹配所帕累托支配的匹配。我们提出了一种新颖的机制，称为配额调整过程（QAP），该机制通过内生地寻找ESOSM及相应的最优配额分配，以改善现有的稳定机制，适用于任何偏好关系。自2021年起，该方法已在日本筑波大学成功实施。

title: Roots of Cultural Diversity
title_zh: 文化多样性的根源
title_primary: 文化多样性的根源
title_secondary: Roots of Cultural Diversity
authors: Oded Galor, Marc Klemp, Daniel C. Wainstock, Samuel Bazzi, Max Posch 等
official: 官方在线 2024-11-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study reveals the pivotal impact of the prehistoric out-of-Africa migration on global variation in the degree of cultural diversity within ethnic and national populations. Drawing on novel diversity measures—encompassing folkloric and musical traditions among indigenous ethnic groups, as well as norms, values, and attitudes in modern societies—an intriguing pattern emerges: societies whose ancestors migrated farther from humanity’s cradle in Africa exhibit lower cultural diversity. These striking findings underscore: (i) the profound role of cultural dynamics in shaping the enduring effects of the out-of-Africa migration on social cohesion, innovativeness, and living standards; (ii) the origins of persistent global variations in cultural expressions within an increasingly interconnected world; and (iii) the roots of variations in societal adaptability to evolving economic and technological landscapes.
abstract_zh: 本研究揭示了史前“走出非洲”迁徙对全球族群及国家人口内部文化多样性程度的决定性影响。借助新颖的多样性度量指标——涵盖原住民族群的民俗与音乐传统，以及现代社会的规范、价值观与态度——一个引人注目的模式浮现：祖先从人类摇篮非洲迁徙距离更远的社会，展现出较低的文化多样性。这些显著发现强调了：（i）文化动态在塑造“走出非洲”迁徙对社会凝聚力、创新能力及生活水平的持久影响中的深远作用；（ii）在日益互联的世界中，全球文化表达持久差异的起源；（iii）社会对不断演变的经济与技术环境适应能力差异的根源。

title: Why Europe needs Eurobonds
title_zh: 欧洲为何需要欧元债券
title_primary: 欧洲为何需要欧元债券
title_secondary: Why Europe needs Eurobonds
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Qingyuan Fang, Leonardo Melosi, Anna Rogantini Picco
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The 2024 reform of the EU fiscal framework makes fiscal adjustment more country-specific and less procyclical. However, it does not eliminate two fundamental tail risks: following a large recession, too little fiscal flexibility can generate deflationary stagnation, while too much can undermine confidence in national debt stabilisation and generate stagflation. This column shows that a Eurobond-financed common fiscal capacity can mitigate both tail risks. Under this proposal, stabilisation of exceptional common shocks is shifted to the euro-area level while responsibility for national debt remains firmly national.
abstract_zh: 2024年欧盟财政框架改革使财政调整更具国别针对性，且减少顺周期性。然而，改革并未消除两大根本性尾部风险：在严重衰退之后，财政灵活性不足可能引发通缩性停滞，而灵活性过度则可能削弱对国家债务稳定的信心，并导致滞胀。本文专栏指出，由欧元债券融资的共同财政能力可同时缓解这两种尾部风险。在该提议下，异常共同冲击的稳定职能被转移至欧元区层面，而国家债务的责任仍牢牢保留在国家层面。

title: When Patents Become Collateral: Intellectual Property Financialization and Corporate Venture Capital Investment
title_zh: 当专利成为抵押品：知识产权金融化与企业风险投资
title_primary: 当专利成为抵押品：知识产权金融化与企业风险投资
title_secondary: When Patents Become Collateral: Intellectual Property Financialization and Corporate Venture Capital Investment
authors: Hao Zhang, Lina Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether patent-backed financing reforms affect firms’ external technology acquisition strategies. Using the staggered rollout of China’s Patent Pledge Financing Pilot (PPFP) across cities, we employ a difference-in-differences design to study its effect on corporate venture capital (CVC) investment. We find that PPFP significantly increases firms’ CVC activity, with the effect concentrated in high-tech CVC, and weaker for state-owned enterprises. These findings are consistent with the view that increasing the financial value of patent assets strengthens firms’ incentives to engage in technology-oriented CVC for external technology sourcing.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了专利质押融资改革是否影响企业的外部技术获取策略。利用中国专利质押融资试点（PPFP）在城市层面的分阶段推行，我们采用双重差分设计研究其对企业风险投资（CVC）的影响。研究发现，PPFP显著提升了企业的CVC活动，且该效应集中于高科技CVC，对国有企业的影响较弱。这些发现与提高专利资产金融价值会增强企业通过技术导向型CVC进行外部技术获取的动机这一观点相符。

title: Innovation, industry equilibrium, and discount rates
title_zh: 创新、行业均衡与贴现率
title_primary: 创新、行业均衡与贴现率
title_secondary: Innovation, industry equilibrium, and discount rates
authors: Maria Cecilia Bustamante, Francesco D'Acunto, Francesca Zucchi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how discount rates affect the level and composition of innovation within an industry. We develop a model in which higher discount rates need not reduce innovation in industry equilibrium, challenging conventional wisdom. While higher discount rates deter entry, effectively acting as entry barriers, they stimulate innovation along the intensive margin, potentially increasing aggregate industry innovation on net. The data support these predictions. The effects are stronger in more R&D intensive industries and industries with greater exposure to systematic risk. Additionally, higher discount rates foster explorative rather than exploitative innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了贴现率如何影响行业内创新的水平与结构。我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，较高的贴现率在行业均衡状态下未必会减少创新，这挑战了传统观念。尽管较高的贴现率阻碍了新企业的进入，实际上起到了进入壁垒的作用，但它们却促进了集约边际上的创新，可能总体上增加行业的整体创新量。数据支持这些预测。在研发密集型更高以及系统性风险暴露更大的行业中，这些效应更为显著。此外，较高的贴现率更倾向于促进探索性创新而非利用性创新。

title: Monopsony, Efficiency, and the Regularization of Undocumented Immigrants
title_zh: 垄断、效率与非法移民的规范化
title_primary: 垄断、效率与非法移民的规范化
title_secondary: Monopsony, Efficiency, and the Regularization of Undocumented Immigrants
authors: George J. Borjas, Anthony Edo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In 1981, President Mitterrand regularized the status of undocumented immigrants in France, who comprised 12 percent of the non-French workforce and about 1 percent of all workers. Employers have monopsony power over undocumented workers because the undocumented find it costly to participate in the open market. By alleviating this labor market imperfection, a regularization program can move the market closer to the efficient competitive equilibrium and increase employment and wages for the authorized workforce. Our empirical analysis reveals that the Mitterrand regularization program raised employment and wages for low-skill native and immigrant men and increased per-capita GDP.
abstract_zh: 1981年，法国总统密特朗对无证移民的身份进行了合法化，这些移民占非法国籍劳动力的12%，约占全体工人的1%。由于无证移民参与公开市场的成本高昂，雇主对他们拥有买方垄断权力。通过缓解这一劳动力市场的不完善，合法化计划能使市场更接近有效竞争均衡，并提高合法劳动力的就业率和工资。我们的实证分析表明，密特朗合法化计划提升了低技能本土及移民男性的就业与工资水平，并增加了人均GDP。

title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
title_zh: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求
title_primary: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求
title_secondary: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
authors: Anusha Chari, Gian Maria Milesi Ferretti
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了外国对美国资产的需求，特别关注美国国债。文章记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别上的构成变化，提供了更接近国籍概念的债权人头寸估计。尽管美国股票价格的上涨在很大程度上解释了净外部头寸的恶化，但外国购买美国国债一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。在过去十年中，外国官方投资者持有的这些证券份额急剧下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额则有所上升。外国官方持有量的下降可以很好地由储备积累减少、美联储持有量增加以及美元对其他储备货币升值来解释。证据与中央银行重新平衡其投资组合以避免货币份额大幅波动的行为一致。地缘经济碎片化与外国官方对美国国债的需求呈负相关，而外国私人需求仍对避险动态敏感。总体而言，本文评估了这些结构性变化如何影响对美国资产的组合偏好，以及在地缘政治和财政不确定性加剧的背景下，它们对美国外部头寸的潜在影响。

title: What doesn’t kill you makes you shorter: The effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood
title_zh: 没杀死你的会让你变矮：产前空气污染对成年身高的影响
title_primary: 没杀死你的会让你变矮：产前空气污染对成年身高的影响
title_secondary: What doesn’t kill you makes you shorter: The effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood
authors: Liping Chen, Yuanyuan Chen, Jiada Lin
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the causal effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood. We employ a two-stage least squares model, using thermal inversions as an instrumental variable for identification. Leveraging data from a nationally representative sample in China, the results show that an increase of 1 μg/m3 in PM2.5 concentrations during gestation reduces height in adulthood by 0.4 cm and normalized height scores by 0.07 standard deviations. These adverse effects on height are primarily driven by exposure to air pollution during the first and second trimesters of pregnancy. Furthermore, the results show that exposure to air pollution after birth does not significantly impact adult height. The mechanism analysis indicates that income reductions that are associated with air pollution are unlikely to be the main pathway through which prenatal air pollution affects long-term height outcomes. Instead, disruptions to maternal health during pregnancy appear to be the dominant mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产前空气污染对成年期身高的因果效应。我们采用两阶段最小二乘模型，以热逆温作为工具变量进行识别。利用中国全国代表性样本的数据，结果显示，孕期PM2.5浓度每增加1微克/立方米，成年期身高减少0.4厘米，标准化身高评分降低0.07个标准差。这些对身高的不利影响主要源于妊娠期第一和第二个三个月的空气污染暴露。此外，结果表明，出生后空气污染暴露对成年身高无显著影响。机制分析显示，与空气污染相关的收入减少不太可能是产前空气污染影响长期身高结果的主要途径；相反，孕期母体健康受损似乎是主导机制。

title: "Does Higher Hospital Quality Save Lives? The Association between" "COVID-19 Deaths and Hospital Quality in the USA
title_zh: 更高的医院质量能否挽救生命？美国COVID-19死亡与医院质量之间的关联
title_primary: 更高的医院质量能否挽救生命？美国COVID-19死亡与医院质量之间的关联
title_secondary: "Does Higher Hospital Quality Save Lives? The Association between" "COVID-19 Deaths and Hospital Quality in the USA
authors: Johannes Kunz, Carol Propper, John Lewis, Michele Fioretti, Victor Saint-Jean 等
official: 官方在线 2020-07-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the association between the quality of hospitals to which residents of a US county are exposed and deaths from COVID-19. We derive a measure of the hospitals accessible to county residents based on ambulance travel patterns. We estimate hospital quality from measures of performance used in a flagship national pay-for-performance program. We find that a standard deviation in local quality- exposure is associated with a roughly 9% lower death rate. The preventive effects of access to high quality hospitals vary sharply by minority composition of the local population.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国某县居民可接触到的医院质量与COVID-19死亡人数之间的关联。我们基于救护车出行模式，推导出县居民可及医院的度量指标。我们利用一项国家级旗舰按绩效付费项目中的绩效衡量标准来评估医院质量。研究发现，当地质量暴露的一个标准差与死亡率降低约9%相关。高质量医院的可及性对预防效果的影响，因当地人口的少数族裔构成不同而存在显著差异。

title: Female labor force participation in historical census microdata
title_zh: 历史人口普查微观数据中的女性劳动力参与
title_primary: 历史人口普查微观数据中的女性劳动力参与
title_secondary: Female labor force participation in historical census microdata
authors: Jørgen Modalsli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How reliable is historical microdata? Understanding historical labor force participation is crucial for assessing long-term trends in economic development and intergenerational mobility. Most existing historical studies are, however, limited to men, and little is known about how reliable quantitative historical sources are when studying labor market outcomes for women. This paper documents that the measurement of women’s economic activity in the 1910 Norwegian population census had a high level of consistency. There is extensive discussion of measurement issues in historical census reports, micro data can reproduce historical census tables with a high degree of accuracy, and other contemporary reports such as industrial censuses and tax statistics confirm the results found in the census. In addition, a double-enumeration feature of the Norwegian census is leveraged to assess consistency between enumerators, finding no indication that precision in the occupational classification of women is any lower than for men. Some potential sources of downward bias are found in the historical census microdata set provided by IPUMS. Based on the results in this paper, historical census data appears well suited to study economic activity using modern econometric methods, for women as well as men. A slight upward revision of the 39% female labor force participation in Norway in 1910 might be in order.
abstract_zh: 历史微观数据的可靠性如何？理解历史劳动力参与率对于评估经济发展和代际流动的长期趋势至关重要。然而，现有的大多数历史研究仅限于男性，关于定量历史资料在研究女性劳动力市场结果时的可靠性知之甚少。本文记录了1910年挪威人口普查中女性经济活动测量的高度一致性。历史普查报告中对测量问题有广泛讨论，微观数据能够高度准确地重现历史普查表格，而其他当代报告如工业普查和税收统计也证实了普查中的结果。此外，利用挪威普查的双重登记特性来评估普查员之间的一致性，未发现女性职业分类的精确度低于男性的迹象。在IPUMS提供的历史普查微观数据集中发现了一些潜在的下行偏差来源。基于本文的结果，历史普查数据似乎非常适合使用现代计量经济学方法研究经济活动，无论是对女性还是男性。对1910年挪威39%的女性劳动力参与率进行轻微上调可能是合适的。

title: From rotational to scalar invariance: Enhancing identifiability in score-driven factor models
title_zh: 从旋转不变性到标量不变性：提升得分驱动因子模型的可识别性
title_primary: 从旋转不变性到标量不变性：提升得分驱动因子模型的可识别性
title_secondary: From rotational to scalar invariance: Enhancing identifiability in score-driven factor models
authors: Giuseppe Buccheri, Fulvio Corsi, Emilija Dzuverovic
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that, for a certain class of scaling matrices including the inverse square-root of the conditional Fisher information, score-driven factor models are identifiable up to a multiplicative scalar constant under very mild restrictions. This result has no analogue in parameter-driven models, as it exploits the different structure of the score-driven factor dynamics. Consequently, score-driven factor models overcome the issue of rotational invariance that typically affects dynamic factor models, thereby enhancing the economic and financial interpretability of the estimated factors. Our restrictions are order-invariant and can be generalized to score-driven factor models with dynamic loadings and nonlinear factor models. We test extensively the identification strategy using simulated and real data. The empirical analysis on financial and macroeconomic data reveals a substantial increase of log-likelihood ratios and significantly improved out-of-sample forecast performance when switching from the classical restrictions adopted in the literature to our more flexible specifications.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于包括条件Fisher信息逆平方根在内的某类缩放矩阵，得分驱动因子模型在非常宽松的限制下可识别至多一个乘性标量常数。这一结果在参数驱动模型中并无对应，因为它利用了得分驱动因子动态的不同结构。因此，得分驱动因子模型克服了通常影响动态因子模型的旋转不变性问题，从而增强了估计因子的经济与金融可解释性。我们的限制具有顺序不变性，并可推广至具有动态载荷的得分驱动因子模型及非线性因子模型。我们通过模拟和真实数据广泛检验了识别策略。对金融和宏观经济数据的实证分析显示，当从文献中采用的经典限制转向我们更灵活的规格时，对数似然比显著增加，且样本外预测性能大幅提升。

title: The Design of Optimal Education Policies
title_zh: 最优教育政策的设计

title: Fiscal capacity and the flypaper effect
title_zh: 财政能力与粘蝇纸效应
title_primary: 财政能力与粘蝇纸效应
title_secondary: Fiscal capacity and the flypaper effect
authors: Rodrigo Saens, Paulo Cox, Carlos Villalobos
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper unifies public choice and public finance accounts of the flypaper effect under fiscal capacity as a common moderator, thereby organizing previously separate explanations into a single comparative-static framework. Using panel data on Chilean municipalities (2001–2021), we find that the flypaper response declines monotonically with fiscal capacity, from a transfer elasticity of 0.92 in the lowest-capacity quintile to statistical indistinguishability from zero in the highest; own-revenue elasticities show the opposite pattern. The gradient is robust to controls for municipality size and across alternative specifications. We read it as a regime statistic of a permanent institutional configuration with centrally fixed tax rates and formula-based intergovernmental grants, not as a treatment effect. The framework integrates the marginal cost of public funds from public finance with electoral accountability and soft budget constraints from public choice, each yielding the same prediction of monotonic decline. Uniform allocation rules amplify rather than neutralize the asymmetries they were designed to address, with implications for the design of intergovernmental transfer systems in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本文将公共选择与公共财政对粘蝇纸效应的解释统一于财政能力这一共同调节变量之下，从而将此前相互独立的解释整合至一个比较静态分析框架中。利用智利市政当局的面板数据（2001-2021年），我们发现粘蝇纸效应随财政能力单调递减：在财政能力最低的五分之一组中，转移支付弹性为0.92，而在最高组中，该弹性在统计上与零无显著差异；自有收入弹性则呈现相反模式。这一梯度关系在控制市政规模变量及采用不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们将其解读为一种制度配置的体制性统计特征——该配置包含中央固定税率与基于公式的政府间转移支付——而非处理效应。该框架将公共财政中的公共资金边际成本与公共选择中的选举问责及软预算约束相整合，三者均得出单调递减的相同预测。统一分配规则非但未能抵消其旨在解决的不对称性，反而加剧了这种不对称，这对发展中国家政府间转移支付体系的设计具有启示意义。本文为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以获取访问权限。

abstract: We examine exchange rate dynamics in cases where the authorities promise (i) to confine a floating rate within a predetermined range, (ii) to peg the currency once it reaches a predetermined future level, and (iii) to unify a system of dual exchange rates. Similarities between these and several related examples of regime switching are stressed. We also discuss how stochastic regime changes can affect some standard statistical tests of hypotheses about exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了当局承诺以下三种情形下的汇率动态：(i) 将浮动汇率限制在预定区间内，(ii) 一旦汇率达到预定的未来水平即实施钉住汇率制度，以及(iii) 统一双重汇率体系。我们强调了这些情形与若干相关制度转换案例之间的相似性。此外，还探讨了随机性制度转换如何影响关于汇率的某些标准统计假设检验。

title: Refugees, camps, and host communities: Evidence from Bangladesh’s humanitarian hosting system
title_zh: 难民、难民营与收容社区：来自孟加拉国人道主义收容系统的证据
title_primary: 难民、难民营与收容社区：来自孟加拉国人道主义收容系统的证据
title_secondary: Refugees, camps, and host communities: Evidence from Bangladesh’s humanitarian hosting system
authors: Alvin Etang Ndip, Sandra Rozo, María José Urbina, Christina Wieser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: By 2025, over 42 million refugees will be hosted in low- and middle-income countries, which rely on one of two models: a humanitarian model centered on international aid and camp-based restrictions on integration, or a development-based model promoting self-reliance and gradual integration. We study the local development impacts of a pure humanitarian model, focusing on Rohingya refugees in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. Combining remote sensing data with longitudinal household surveys, we exploit variation in distance to refugee camps before and after the refugee influx to explore the effects of this refugee hosting model. We find that areas closer to camps experienced higher economic growth following the arrival of the Rohingya. Household-level evidence points to humanitarian aid as the key mechanism: host communities near camps exhibit higher job formality, aid access, and food consumption. However, proximity to camps is also associated with adverse effects, including increased safety concerns and a higher prevalence of communicable diseases among host populations. These results are consistent with epidemiological spillovers and increased pressure on local infrastructure offsetting gains from expanded service provision.
abstract_zh: 到2025年，超过4200万难民将被安置在中低收入国家，这些国家依赖两种模式之一：一种是以国际援助和基于难民营的融合限制为中心的人道主义模式，另一种是促进自力更生和逐步融合的发展型模式。我们研究纯粹人道主义模式对当地发展的影响，重点关注孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔的罗兴亚难民。结合遥感数据和纵向家庭调查，我们利用难民涌入前后距难民营距离的变化来探讨这种难民收容模式的影响。我们发现，在罗兴亚人抵达后，靠近难民营的地区经历了更高的经济增长。家庭层面的证据表明，人道主义援助是关键机制：靠近难民营的收容社区表现出更高的就业正规性、援助获取和食品消费。然而，靠近难民营也伴随着不利影响，包括收容人口中安全担忧增加和传染病患病率上升。这些结果与流行病学溢出效应以及当地基础设施压力增大抵消了服务扩展带来的收益相一致。

abstract: We examine the impact of short-term temperature changes on voting behavior in the Brazilian presidential elections from 2010 to 2018, focusing on the candidacy of Marina Silva, a prominent pro-environment politician. Using data on municipality level voting and daily wet bulb temperature, we find that an increase in temperature on election day increases votes for Marina Silva. We argue that this effect is driven by the salience of climate change issues, which influences last-minute voting decisions. Our analysis also shows that temperature variations in the days preceding the election have a limited impact on voting outcomes, highlighting the transient nature of climate salience effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010年至2018年巴西总统选举期间短期气温变化对投票行为的影响，重点关注著名环保政治家玛丽娜·席尔瓦的竞选活动。利用市级投票数据与每日湿球温度数据，我们发现选举日气温升高会增加玛丽娜·席尔瓦的得票数。我们认为这一效应源于气候变化议题的显著性，这种显著性影响了选民在最后一刻的投票决策。分析还表明，选举前几天的气温变化对投票结果影响有限，凸显了气候显著性效应的短暂性特征。

title: Ancestral irrigation and collective climate action
title_zh: 祖先灌溉与集体气候行动
title_primary: 祖先灌溉与集体气候行动
title_secondary: Ancestral irrigation and collective climate action
authors: Trung V. Vu, James B. Ang
official: 来源期次 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the long-term legacy of ancestral irrigation for contemporary climate change policies. Using geographic suitability for irrigated agriculture as a plausibly exogenous source of variation in historical irrigation adoption, we find that societies whose ancestors jointly practiced irrigated agriculture during the pre-industrial era tend to adopt less effective climate change policies today. Additional evidence suggests that pro-climate political responses to the growing salience of climate action, driven by exposure to severe natural disasters, are significantly weaker in societies historically dependent on irrigated agriculture. We propose and document empirically that ancestral irrigation, marked by intensive neighborhood-based cooperation and interdependence, contributed to the early formation of tight kinship networks. These networks likely constrained impersonal cooperation across kin boundaries, weakening collective pro-climate action.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了祖先灌溉对当代气候变化政策的长期影响。利用灌溉农业的地理适宜性作为历史灌溉采用的外生变异来源，我们发现，在前工业化时期，其祖先共同实践灌溉农业的社会，在当今往往采取效果较差的气候变化政策。进一步证据表明，受严重自然灾害暴露驱动的气候行动日益凸显，而在历史上依赖灌溉农业的社会中，亲气候的政治响应显著较弱。我们提出并通过实证证明，祖先灌溉以密集的邻里合作与相互依赖为特征，促进了紧密亲属网络的早期形成。这些网络可能限制了跨越亲属界限的非个人化合作，从而削弱了集体亲气候行动。

title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion in china and its implications for food production potential
title_zh: 中国建设用地扩张优先占用优质耕地的时空动态及其对粮食生产潜力的影响
title_primary: 中国建设用地扩张优先占用优质耕地的时空动态及其对粮食生产潜力的影响
title_secondary: Spatiotemporal dynamics of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion in china and its implications for food production potential
authors: Shuangqing Sheng, Wei Song, Xiangzheng Deng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Global food security is increasingly challenged by issues such as population growth, cropland decline, and rapid urbanization, among which construction land expansion and its occupation of high-quality cropland have become key drivers affecting food production potential. However, existing studies have largely focused on changes in cropland quantity, with little attention to the selective occupation of high-quality cropland as well as its implications for food security. To mitigate this gap, this study develops an Indicator of the Tendency toward Preferential Occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion (ITPO) based on the China Land Cover Dataset (CLCD) and farmland production potential data, which enables a quantitative assessment of the selective effects of urban expansion on cropland quality structure, hoping to provide new insights into the “land-use + food security” nexus. According to the results, several facts have been identified: (1) cropland occupied by construction land expansion exhibits a clear spatial pattern from eastern coastal regions toward inland areas. From 1985–2020, 85.93% of newly expanded construction land originated from cropland, of which 55.8% was high-quality cropland. Such occupation is primarily concentrated in major urban agglomerations, including the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Chengdu–Chongqing regions; (2) preferential occupation shows significant spatial and temporal heterogeneities, with persistent high-intensity clusters in eastern, northeastern, and central China, while western China maintains a relatively high proportion of statistically significant counties, approaching 60% in most periods (approximately 55% during 1991–2000); (3) the spatial center of both Construction Land Occupation of Cropland (CLOC) and ITPO shift westward in the study period, with a more significant displacement observed for ITPO, indicating an increasing westward redistribution of pressure on high-quality cropland; and (4) cumulative losses in food production potential caused by construction land expansion during 1985–2020 are estimated at 4.59 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.15% of total cropland potential), of which 2.69 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.09%) was high-quality cropland. Overall, although the relative intensity of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland has declined over time, its absolute loss remains substantial due to higher unit productivity and spatial concentration. By incorporating the cropland quality structure into the analysis, this study advances the understanding of the relationship between construction land expansion and food security, providing quantitative evidence to support differentiated cropland protection and territorial spatial governance strategies.
abstract_zh: 全球粮食安全日益受到人口增长、耕地减少和快速城市化等问题的挑战，其中建设用地扩张及其对优质耕地的占用已成为影响粮食生产潜力的关键因素。然而，现有研究多聚焦于耕地数量的变化，较少关注对优质耕地的选择性占用及其对粮食安全的影响。为弥补这一不足，本研究基于中国土地覆盖数据集（CLCD）和农田生产潜力数据，构建了建设用地扩张对优质耕地偏好占用倾向指标（ITPO），从而能够定量评估城市扩张对耕地质量结构的选择性效应，以期为“土地利用+粮食安全”关联提供新的见解。研究结果显示：（1）建设用地扩张所占用的耕地呈现从东部沿海地区向内陆地区转移的明显空间格局。1985—2020年间，新增建设用地中85.93%来源于耕地，其中55.8%为优质耕地。此类占用主要集中在京津冀、长三角、珠三角和成渝等主要城市群；（2）偏好占用表现出显著的时空异质性，东部、东北和中部地区存在持续的高强度集聚区，而西部地区统计显著县份比例相对较高，多数时期接近60%（1991—2000年间约为55%）；（3）研究期内，建设用地占用耕地（CLOC）和ITPO的空间重心均向西移动，其中ITPO的位移更为显著，表明优质耕地面临的压力日益向西部再分配；（4）1985—2020年间，建设用地扩张导致的粮食生产潜力累计损失估计为4.59×10¹⁰千克（占耕地总潜力的0.15%），其中优质耕地损失为2.69×10¹⁰千克（占0.09%）。总体而言，尽管优质耕地偏好占用的相对强度随时间有所下降，但由于其较高的单位生产力和空间集中性，绝对损失仍然可观。通过将耕地质量结构纳入分析，本研究深化了对建设用地扩张与粮食安全关系的理解，为差异化耕地保护和国土空间治理策略提供了定量证据支持。

title: Affine Virtual Values and the Generalized Pareto distribution
title_zh: 仿射虚拟值与广义帕累托分布
title_primary: 仿射虚拟值与广义帕累托分布
title_secondary: Affine Virtual Values and the Generalized Pareto distribution
authors: Paolo Morganti
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper establishes a precise link between the tail behavior of a distribution and the structure of its Virtual Value. We show that the only continuously differentiable distributions whose Virtual Value is linear on an interval coincide, on that interval, with a Generalized Pareto distribution. This equivalence yields explicit expressions for optimal cutoffs and implies that, within this class, comparative statics of allocation and pricing rules are governed by a single primitive, the tail index. Thin tails lead to the familiar monotone adjustment of prices, whereas heavy tails reverse the sign of the response and produce countercyclical pricing. The analysis also demonstrates that widely used textbook distributions acquire an approximately affine Virtual Value in their upper tails whenever their expectations are finite. Under standard regularity conditions from Extreme Value Theory, the tail Virtual Value converges to an affine form, with slope equal to the underlying tail index. These results provide a unified framework for studying allocation, mechanism design and monopoly pricing in environments where high valuations play a central role.
abstract_zh: 本文在分布的尾部行为与其虚拟价值结构之间建立了精确联系。我们证明，唯一在某一区间上具有线性虚拟价值的连续可微分布，在该区间上与广义帕累托分布一致。这一等价关系为最优截断值提供了显式表达式，并意味着在此类分布中，配置与定价规则的比较静态分析由单一原始参数——尾部指数——所支配。薄尾分布导致熟悉的单调价格调整，而厚尾分布则使响应符号反转，产生逆周期定价。分析还表明，当期望有限时，广泛使用的教科书分布在其上尾部分近似具有仿射虚拟价值。在极值理论的标准正则条件下，尾部虚拟价值收敛于仿射形式，其斜率等于潜在尾部指数。这些结果为研究高估值起核心作用的环境中的配置、机制设计与垄断定价提供了统一框架。

title: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
title_zh: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法
title_primary: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法
title_secondary: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
authors: Kristof Bosmans, Z. Emel Öztürk
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We formulate three sets of axioms to measure inequality of opportunity. First, the basic axioms that any relative measure should satisfy. Second, axioms that capture the ex ante perspective, focusing on inequality between individuals with different circumstances. Third, axioms that capture the ex post perspective, focusing on inequality among individuals with the same responsibility characteristics. Based on these axioms, we characterize the ex ante and ex post classes of inequality of opportunity measures. We also discuss how well existing measures in the literature adhere to the axioms.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了三组公理来度量机会不平等。第一组是任何相对度量方法均应满足的基本公理。第二组公理捕捉事前视角，聚焦于不同环境禀赋个体之间的不平等。第三组公理捕捉事后视角，聚焦于具有相同责任特征个体之间的不平等。基于这些公理，我们刻画了事前与事后两类机会不平等度量方法。同时，本文还探讨了现有文献中的度量方法对这些公理的遵循程度。

title: A Network View on Portfolio Risk
title_zh: 投资组合风险的网络视角
title_primary: 投资组合风险的网络视角
title_secondary: A Network View on Portfolio Risk
authors: Wolfgang Karl Härdle, Rui Ren, Zijin Wang, W. L. K. Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-05-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Portfolio performance depends on interactions inside the network of assets. In high dimensions, these interactions are rare and sparse, therefore an inherent and indispensable portfolio risk, network risk, is difficult to quantify. Here a portfolio risk decomposition method is proposed that leads to analytical solutions that provide insights into the accounts for network and idiosyncratic risks. The technical platform is based on Dantzig-type estimator for covariance matrix and eigenvector centrality, which helps reduce estimation error in high-dimensional cases for portfolio optimization. Empirical results show that the network portfolio approach outperforms existing methods out-of-sample on a real dataset and demonstrate the solidity and reliability of our network portfolio and estimation methods from a practical perspective.

title: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
title_zh: 非强制性机制：对次要目标稳健的机制设计
title_primary: 非强制性机制：对次要目标稳健的机制设计
title_secondary: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
authors: Renato Paes Leme, Jon Schneider, Hanrui Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study mechanism design when agents may have hidden secondary goals which will play a role when the primary utility of the outcomes is the same. We show that in such cases, a mechanism is immune to strategic manipulation if and only if it is incentive compatible with regard to primary utility -- a property we term "primary incentive compatibility" -- and nonbossy -- a well-studied property in the context of matching and allocation mechanisms. We give complete characterizations of primarily incentive-compatible and nonbossy mechanisms in various settings, including auctions with single-parameter agents and public decision settings where all agents share a common outcome. In particular, we show that in the single-item setting, a mechanism is primarily incentive compatible, individually rational, and nonbossy if and only if it is a sequential posted-price mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人可能拥有隐藏的次要目标时，这些目标在主要效用结果相同的情况下会发挥作用时的机制设计问题。我们证明，在这种情况下，一个机制对策略操纵具有免疫性，当且仅当它相对于主要效用是激励相容的——我们称之为“主要激励相容”性质——并且是非专断的——这是在匹配和分配机制背景下被广泛研究的性质。我们给出了在多种情境下主要激励相容且非专断机制的完整刻画，包括单参数代理人的拍卖以及所有代理人共享共同结果的公共决策情境。特别地，我们证明在单物品情境下，一个机制是主要激励相容、个体理性且非专断的，当且仅当它是一个序贯标价机制。

title: Membership mechanism
title_zh: 会员机制
title_primary: 会员机制
title_secondary: Membership mechanism
authors: Seung Han Yoo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The seller seeks to sell two different items by bundling participation. Membership allows only members to buy either item or both. A membership mechanism thus specifies a member set and a fee as well as allocation and payment rules. We first establish the revenue-maximizing mechanism given a modified valuation distribution incorporating the member set, which also resolves the existence problem. The optimal membership mechanism enables us to compare between bundling participation and separate participation, suggesting conditions under which membership dominates selling two goods separately: interplay between the number of bidders and the degree of the stochastic dominance of valuation distributions. This mechanism also provides a rationale for secret reserve prices, a long-standing puzzle in theory.
abstract_zh: 卖方试图通过捆绑参与来销售两种不同的物品。会员资格仅允许会员购买其中任一物品或两者兼有。因此，会员机制规定了会员集合、费用以及分配和支付规则。我们首先在考虑会员集合的修正估值分布下，确立了收益最大化的机制，这也解决了存在性问题。最优会员机制使我们能够比较捆绑参与与单独参与，提出了会员制优于分别销售两种商品的条件：竞标者数量与估值分布随机优势程度之间的相互作用。该机制还为秘密保留价这一理论中长期存在的谜题提供了合理解释。

title: Evaluating non-clairvoyant dynamic mechanisms: Theory and experiment
title_zh: 评估非预见性动态机制：理论与实验
title_primary: 评估非预见性动态机制：理论与实验
title_secondary: Evaluating non-clairvoyant dynamic mechanisms: Theory and experiment
authors: Shan Gui, Daniel Houser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study dynamic mechanism design in non-clairvoyant environments, where sellers cannot forecast future demand and buyers hold private information. Using two laboratory experiments, we evaluate two non-clairvoyant mechanisms: the dynamic maximin-optimal non-clairvoyant mechanism (DM, Mirrokni et al., 2020) and the repeated static optimal mechanism (RS, Myerson, 1981). Experiment 1 compares DM and RS between demand-distribution scenarios and shows that non-clairvoyant mechanisms perform as intended: DM either outperforms or underperforms RS depending on the scenario, consistent with theory. Building on these results, Experiment 2 examines the optimal clairvoyant mechanism (OC) and a different implementation of DM. In surprising contrast to theory, OC using full information performs no better than the non-clairvoyant mechanisms, while DM performs equally well across implementation forms. Our results highlight the practical importance of non-clairvoyant mechanisms as implementable approaches to dynamic auction design in uncertain markets.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了非预见性环境下的动态机制设计，其中卖方无法预测未来需求，买方持有私人信息。通过两项实验室实验，我们评估了两种非预见性机制：动态最大最小最优非预见性机制（DM，Mirrokni等人，2020）和重复静态最优机制（RS，Myerson，1981）。实验1在需求分布情景之间比较了DM和RS，并表明非预见性机制按预期运作：DM的表现优于或劣于RS取决于具体情景，与理论一致。基于这些结果，实验2考察了最优预见性机制（OC）和DM的另一种实施方式。与理论形成惊人对比的是，利用完全信息的OC表现并不优于非预见性机制，而DM在不同实施形式下表现相当。我们的结果强调了非预见性机制作为不确定市场中动态拍卖设计的可行方法，具有实际重要性。

title: Consumer food waste as household technical inefficiency across countries and time
title_zh: 跨国与跨时期家庭技术无效率中的消费者食物浪费
title_primary: 跨国与跨时期家庭技术无效率中的消费者食物浪费
title_secondary: Consumer food waste as household technical inefficiency across countries and time
authors: Dominic Vieira, Emiliano Lopez Barrera, Marcelo Dias Paes Ferreira
official: 官方在线 2026-01-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Despite its implications for global food security and sustainability, quantitative analysis of consumer food waste across countries and over time is scarce. We examine food waste dynamics across 145 countries from 1995 to 2013 by modeling uneaten calories as a form of household‐level technical inefficiency, using an input distance function within a panel stochastic frontier framework. Unlike prior studies that rely on production functions, our input‐oriented specification reflects consumer behavior by treating body mass as a predetermined level and analyzing the calories required to sustain it—aligning the specification with consumer behavior. The panel structure allows decomposition of inefficiency into time‐invariant (persistent) and time‐varying (transient) components and clarifies development‐related factors associated with food waste. Our results show that persistent inefficiency is the dominant source of household food waste, with fruit and vegetable consumption associated with higher overall levels of transient inefficiency. We find evidence of an inverted‐U (Kuznets‐style) relationship, where food waste tends to rise at lower income levels but declines as countries become wealthier. Between 1995 and 2013, global food waste increased by an estimated 336 million metric tons, with middle‐income countries—particularly Brazil, Russia, India, and China—accounting for a large share of the rise. This novel application establishes a foundational, generalizable framework for longitudinal, indirect measurement of food waste across spatial scales and levels of aggregation. Additionally, by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components, this framework enables dynamic computable general equilibrium and partial equilibrium simulations, integrated with life‐cycle assessment, that distinguish structural changes from short‐run shocks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管消费者食物浪费对全球粮食安全和可持续性具有重要影响，但跨国家、跨时间的定量分析仍然稀缺。我们通过将未消耗卡路里建模为家庭层面技术无效率的一种形式，利用面板随机前沿框架中的投入距离函数，考察了1995年至2013年间145个国家的食物浪费动态。与以往依赖生产函数的研究不同，我们的投入导向规范通过将体重视为预定水平并分析维持该体重所需的卡路里来反映消费者行为——从而使规范与消费者行为保持一致。面板结构允许将无效率分解为时间不变（持久性）和时间变化（暂时性）成分，并阐明与食物浪费相关的发展因素。我们的结果表明，持久性无效率是家庭食物浪费的主要来源，水果和蔬菜消费与较高水平的整体暂时性无效率相关。我们发现了倒U型（库兹涅茨式）关系的证据，即食物浪费在较低收入水平时趋于上升，但随着国家变得更加富裕而下降。在1995年至2013年间，全球食物浪费估计增加了3.36亿公吨，其中中等收入国家——尤其是巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国——占据了增长的大部分份额。这一新颖的应用建立了一个基础性、可推广的框架，用于跨空间尺度和聚合层面对食物浪费进行纵向、间接测量。此外，通过将无效率分解为持久性和暂时性成分，该框架能够实现动态可计算一般均衡和局部均衡模拟，并与生命周期评估相结合，从而区分结构性变化与短期冲击。

title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义理论
title_primary: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义理论
title_secondary: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
authors: Gabriele Gratton, Barton Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换经验丰富的公务员，而这些新人将随时间积累经验。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们能更有效地提供公共产品，并更胜任识别紧急威胁。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两种关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多主导政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持以下观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并论证我们的模型有助于解释大型稳健民主国家中反精英民粹主义的兴起。

title: Forecasting the sustainability of workers pension systems in China: a comparative analysis of pre- and post-delay retirement policies
title_zh: 预测中国职工养老金体系的可持续性：延迟退休政策实施前后的比较分析
title_primary: 预测中国职工养老金体系的可持续性：延迟退休政策实施前后的比较分析
title_secondary: Forecasting the sustainability of workers pension systems in China: a comparative analysis of pre- and post-delay retirement policies
authors: Haiwei Yang, Yan Sun, Sumei Zeng, Renke Li, Yucong You
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Workers Pension Insurance accounts for more than 90% of China’s basic social pension income and expenditure. This scheme is a partially funded design that is pronounced sensitivity to demographic shifts. Persistently low fertility and accelerated population ageing jeopardize the system’s long-term solvency, rendering an actuarial evaluation imperative. Drawing on data from the United Nations’ World Population Prospects 2024 and official Chinese statistical sources, we calibrate an actuarial model to project the system’s sustainability. Our simulations indicate that, absent of a delayed-retirement reform, the pension system is projected to record its first annual cash-flow shortfall in 2033 and to exhaust its cumulative reserves by 2042. Under a phased retirement-age increase, the first cash-flow deficit and reserve depletion are deferred to 2049 and 2058, respectively. By 2100, the system is still expected to accumulate an unfunded deficit of approximately CNY 1715 trillion. Consequently, while the delayed retirement policy may provide temporary relief for pension payment pressures, it fails to resolve the underlying long-term viability of the pension system.
abstract_zh: 职工养老保险占中国基本社会养老保险收支的90%以上。该制度采用部分积累制设计，对人口结构变化高度敏感。持续的低生育率和加速的人口老龄化正危及该体系的长期偿付能力，因此进行精算评估势在必行。基于联合国《世界人口展望2024》及中国官方统计数据，我们校准了一个精算模型以预测该体系的可持续性。模拟结果显示，若不实施延迟退休改革，养老金体系预计将在2033年首次出现年度现金流缺口，并于2042年耗尽累计储备。若采取渐进式延迟退休年龄方案，首次现金流赤字和储备耗尽将分别推迟至2049年和2058年。到2100年，该体系预计仍将积累约1715万亿元人民币的无资金准备赤字。因此，延迟退休政策虽能暂时缓解养老金支付压力，但无法从根本上解决养老金体系的长期可持续性问题。
